summary: Planning-only split of I01f1b2 into pending same-B1 children I01f1b2a (recoverable public-only route ownership/lifecycle and actual Windows/WSL/device transport qualification) and I01f1b2b (normal-APK combined environment handoff, repeated-wait/failure/reset/restart qualification and I01f2 documentation). The selected parent remains in-progress with its original outcome and all three checks unchanged. No controller/runtime/build changes, device/service starts, transport or product acceptance, independent review or release gate passed.
selectionReason: Clean master matches the supplied startCommit; D-304 explicitly authorizes the application plan, findings are empty and B1 group review is not due before I01-I04. I01f1b2 is the earliest eligible child after completed I01f1b1 and I01e. Source inspection confirms the controller still refuses every ADB mapping, Windows ownership covers services only, wait publishes services-only readiness, and normal-app startup is a separate observation. Implementing routing therefore requires recoverable ownership/partial-failure/cleanup semantics and actual cross-OS transport qualification before integrating a combined APK/environment descriptor and restart/reset revalidation. Split those two coherent layers before coding rather than assume a Windows reverse mapping reaches Linux loopback or weaken existing foreign-resource safeguards. No priority skipped or parent scope reduced.

children.I01f1b2a: Extend/qualify explicit public-only route attachment, validation, exact owned removal, collision/foreign-state refusal and recoverable partial failure in the existing device controller. Measure actual Windows/WSL/device HTTP to a real owned I01e environment and retain backend/source bytes/hashes/origins, private-port isolation and exact cleanup evidence. Attaching routes invalidates services-only success; subsequent wait must validate the attachment. No final normal-APK combined descriptor is claimed by this transport-only child.
children.I01f1b2b: Integrate the qualified routing with normal-APK install/production startup observation, repeated fail-closed combined wait and capture, actual broken-route recovery, explicit Compose reset revalidation, retained in-scenario app/backend restart and full exact cleanup. Publish the complete endpoint/configuration/evidence/setup/wait/capture/unroute/cleanup handoff for I01f2. No absent application networking/auth/downloader, Kotlin scenario or instrumentation acceptance.

planning.dependencies: I01f1b2a inherits I01f1b2's completed I01f1b1/I01e dependencies; I01f1b2b depends on I01f1b2a. A later I01f1b2 parent qualifies both children against its unchanged full outcome/checks, followed by I01f1b and I01f1 combined qualification before I01f2. No child depends on an open ancestor. I01f2/I01f3/I01f/I01/I02-I04 ordering and B1 full-capability review remain unchanged.
scopePreservation: Keep both existing public loopback port numbers and configured source art origins; do not assume Windows ADB reverse reaches WSL loopback. Measure the actual topology. Use an explicit loopback-only relay only if the measurement requires it, recording exact targets/process/start identity and checking busy/foreign resources before mutation. No wildcard listener, global networking change, private health/admin/reset/mailbox/DB/SMTP forward, production trust relaxation or permission expansion.

The current empty-mapping invariant becomes an exact recorded-owned-set invariant, never a disabled check. Retain mapping/relay intent before creation, no-rebind/collision refusal, partial failure recovery and exact removal; all forward/reverse state outside that set remains a refusal, including foreign serials. Never run remove-all or adopt the default ADB service. Captures precede cleanup and unrelated device/service inventories remain intact.

Only fresh environment ownership/readiness, device route validation and current normal-app startup can produce the combined handoff. Once attached, repeated wait must not silently fall back to service readiness. Failed setup/revalidation removes stale combined success and returns nonzero; explicit unroute restores the independently usable services-only path. A descriptor remains a checked snapshot, not a perpetual lease or proof of an absent product network client.

Both children require actual owned API29 non-GMS devices and real I01e images/Compose services, not only mocked Python unit tests or the historical browser fixture. Backend public 404 and synthetic source metadata/catalog/art hashes are infrastructure oracles; the second child additionally retains actual normal-APK screenshot/hierarchy/package/signer/API/storage startup. Neither is an Appium/Kotlin UI journey or execution of the pending 14 Android storage tests.

Explicit Compose reset between independent scenarios and subsequent environment revalidation are distinct from retained force-stop/relaunch and backend restart within one scenario. No implicit Android clear/uninstall/backend reset, seeded account/game data or product action injection. Fresh Android-data qualification remains I01f2; multi-device/cold-boot/reset repeats remain I01f3. No child-level independent review, parent closure or release-gate update.
